title: InvalidStateTransitionError -> HTTP 409 mapping not on origin/codex/qe-governance-integration-20260509
description: Carved out from BUG-023 follow-up per Stage 4 P2.1 review feedback (2026-05-11). BUG-023 promoted the strategy_pkg.transition_status atomicity fix to verified after Codex round-2 review (commit 5bce68c, drawer 72c82167). However the *paper-v2* branch carries an additional commit 4528a32 that maps InvalidStateTransitionError to HTTP 409 (semantically correct: state-machine conflict is a 409, not a 400). That mapping is not on origin/codex/qe-governance-integration-20260509 yet. While transition_status itself is now atomic, the HTTP layer still answers 400 on this branch, which leaks the state-machine error as if it were an input-validation error. Codex commit d1ca0ba (per cross-tool drawer) appears to bring the mapping over but is not yet on main. Track separately so BUG-023 stays cleanly verified and the cherry-pick / merge state has its own ticket.

trigger_condition.scenario: POST /api/v1/strategy-packages/<pkg>/enable-paper hits an invalid state transition

reproduce_command: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8011/api/v1/strategy-packages/<pkg_already_enabled>/enable-paper  # current branch returns 400 instead of 409
required_verification: After the cherry-pick / merge lands on the integration branch, replay the reproduce_command and confirm HTTP 409.
Add a regression test asserting raise_exception_handler maps InvalidStateTransitionError to HTTP 409.
Once verified on the integration branch, this BUG can be closed.
closure_requirements: BUG-023 cross-reference unchanged (it remains verified for the atomicity fix scope)

events.note: Carved out from BUG-023 verified-but-with-caveats event. Codex commit d1ca0ba on the integration branch is the candidate cherry-pick. Filed separately per Stage 4 P2.1 review feedback so BUG-023's verified status is not contaminated by an unrelated follow-up.

Codex pipeline Stage 4+5 r1 review (drawer 7fc3bb2bb920914b1991878d) confirmed d1ca0ba is ancestor of origin/codex/qe-governance-integration-20260509 and that backend/routers/strategy_packages.py:146-147 already contains the InvalidStateTransitionError -> HTTP 409 mapping. Promoted to verified per dual-party verify protocol (codex_app verifies a claude_code-filed bug whose actual fix was implemented by codex_app earlier; the cross-toolchain check here is that pipeline-foundation Claude session verified the file:line evidence against the Codex-reported commit).
